title: 21.29. Hetuduka, Hīnattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahetuṁ nahīnaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā hetu hīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.

Nahetuṁ namajjhimaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nanahetuṁ namajjhimaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ napaṇītaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā hetu paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
